title: BallisticsCalibrationContract
description: Calibration bundles: the game's own ballistic tables and engine oracle samples that a ballistics catalog's flight model must reproduce within tolerance before the catalog is accepted. The root is one bundle, the `calibration` part of POST /api/v1/ballistics-catalogs. A bundle names its catalog by id, version and the SHA-256 of the catalog bytes, and both are pinned to one game build and export generation.

CalibrationBundle.description: Every calibration case for one catalog version. Every (shell, charge) of the catalog has at least one native table and at least one simulation sample.

catalog_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact catalog bytes this bundle calibrates.

resources.description: Every game resource the tables were read from, with the SHA-256 of its exported bytes.

CalibrationResource.description: One game resource: its 16-hex-digit GUID, its resource name and the SHA-256 of its exported bytes. Matches ballistics-catalog.schema.json#/definitions/CatalogResource.

OracleRun.description: The Workbench oracle plugin run the samples and the catalog's gravity come from.

gravity_reported_m_s2.description: Gravity the physics world reported during the run; the catalog's gravity_m_s2 equals it.

output_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw oracle output the samples were trimmed from.

NativeTable.description: One game ballistic table for a shell at one muzzle speed coefficient. A row passes when its range lies within the model's range over its elevation plus or minus 1 mil (6400 convention) and the model's time of flight at its elevation is within 0.1 s.

NativeTableRow.description: One table row. The game does not store the row's elevation: elevation_mils_6400 is assigned from the oracle's forward-angle sample of equal range and time of flight. column_1 is the game's second column, kept verbatim and not interpreted.

WindTable.description: One game wind table for a shell at one muzzle speed coefficient and one wind speed.

WindTableRow.description: One wind table row: elevation in radians, range and apex height in metres, and the game's undecoded value list kept verbatim.

OracleSample.description: One engine oracle call: forward_angle (range and time of flight at an elevation), simulation (impact point and time of flight for a full launch state with wind and target height) or altitude_difference (aim and time of flight for a height difference). inputs and outputs carry the call's arguments and results under the engine's parameter names, in metres, seconds and radians.

Slug.description: Lowercase identifier: letters and digits in groups joined by single underscores or hyphens.

EnfusionGuid.description: Enfusion resource or export GUID: 16 uppercase hexadecimal digits, no braces.

GameBuild.description: Arma Reforger build number, dotted (for example 1.8.0.13).
